== Wiki-based queue ==

* '''Edits being rejected — what's going on?''' We likely had far too many edits in a short burst and hit issues; might be some weird bot-account configuration too.
: '''✓ 2026-07-14 (bot):''' Diagnosed. It is NOT our request rate, our IP, or our User-Agent. shinto.miraheze.org sits behind a '''Cloudflare managed challenge''' (`cf-mitigated: challenge`) on the ''whole zone'' — api.php, article pages, and the site root all return 403 for every client (our bot UA, a real browser, curl, wget). '''aelaki.miraheze.org returns 200 for the identical request from the same IP and UA''', so it's specific to the shinto zone. A headless bot can't solve a JS challenge, and the only UAs Cloudflare lets through (bare python-requests/urllib) are exactly the ones Miraheze's own UA policy then blocks — so no UA threads it. Fix is Miraheze-side (relax the challenge / Under Attack Mode on shinto), or it lifts on its own. Detail: <code>docs/wiki_403_audit_2026-07-11.md</code>. (Bot UA was still bumped to the new canonical EmmaBot/2.0 per your request, in case it helps once the zone calms.)
: This one is kind of tautological because in the event that this does get resolved, it's not going to be here anymore.
* ''Analyze this'' https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q137721156 — what's going on with the deities? I want an analysis on the qualifiers used, because a lot are pretty good, or we might be overlooking them.
: '''✓ 2026-07-11 (bot):''' Done — <code>docs/deity_qualifier_analysis_2026-07.md</code>. Q137721156 (日月神社) uses a gold-standard model: each 祭神 (P825) carries P1932 "object named as" (原文表記, the source's exact spelling) + a book reference (神奈川県神社誌, page 357, NDL persistent id). But it's rare — only 80 of 21,405 Japanese P825 statements carry P1932, and 77 are from that same book; P143 "imported from Japanese Wikipedia" is the DOMINANT reference marker (3,339 vs 1,441 with the URL) yet our importer was missing it. Acted: (1) added S143=Q177837 to the deity importer + all jawiki importers where it's the corpus standard; (2) the P3831=主祭神 principal-deity role is essentially unused — the generator emits it, just needs the drip; (3) prefectural 神社誌 are ~17 NDL-viewable, so the book-citation model is extensible. Also fixed 41 malformed multi-name P1932 values.
